scenarios.name: Retain a selected file name after changing the file-list selection

scenario_steps.name: the user creates a new unsaved metric part in the MCAD Software
the user presses Control+S to open Save As
the Save As dialog is open for a new part in the MCAD Software
the current folder is a writable copy of `fixtures/cad/document-saving/SaveAsNativeFolder` with its part file and subfolder
the user selects `ExistingPart.opd` in the file list
the file is highlighted and its name appears in the file name field
the user selects the subfolder with a single click
the subfolder is highlighted without opening
the file name field still displays the selected part file name
the user clicks empty space in the file list
no file or folder is highlighted
the file name field still displays the part file name
the new unsaved part remains active
